decision.reason: [ev-e35673fcb6a1] is a single changelog line saying a CI-scoped fix makes the compatibility table generator "handle major versions", and it points to PRs #22370/#22371 for details. It does not say how the generator behaved before or after, or whether anything shipped is affected (for example the published compatibility table or a release artifact). It also says nothing about which environments are exposed or what happens if an operator does nothing. Writing the subject, change, applicability and consequence would mean guessing that a CI-only fix has no effect on customers, so we need the PR description or diff.
